subject: Edge finishing and assembly quality
hook: Raw board edge to finished edge in one pass.
ig:
Raw board edge to finished edge in one pass. This is what happens to your panels on our edge bander.

The raw edge of a cut board shows its core. Left like that, it chips, takes on moisture and looks unfinished.

The process:
The panel is fed into the edge bander.
ABS in the thickness on your cutting list is applied to the edge.
It's trimmed flush to the face of the board.
Every edge is checked by hand and eye before the panel goes on the trolley.

We run 0.4, 1 and 2 mm ABS, matched to the board décor you specify.

If you're a fitter, joiner or small maker without your own edge bander, this is the job we can take off your hands, on its own or alongside cutting, drilling and assembly.

Comment EDGE and we'll send you the link to our edge banding service.
fb:
Ever watched an edge bander at work? Here's one in our Hanley workshop taking a raw cut panel to a finished, banded edge.

The ABS strip goes on in the thickness you've asked for, is trimmed flush to the face, and every edge gets checked before it goes on the trolley.

We offer edge banding to the trade, either on its own or with panel cutting, drilling and cabinet assembly. If you're a fitter or joiner who'd rather not tie up time edging, have a look at the service.
